title: Hydration Reminder
description: Get your daily water target from body weight, log every glass, and get reminded on a schedule you set.
howto: Enter your body weight to get a daily water target.
Log each glass with one tap as you drink.
Set a reminder interval and keep the tab open for nudges.

faqs.q: How is the water target calculated?
faqs.a: About 35 ml per kg of body weight (roughly 0.5 oz per lb) — a common baseline. Exercise, heat and illness raise needs.
Moderate coffee and tea do contribute to hydration, but water is the cleanest baseline to track.

faqs.q: Why does the log reset each day?
faqs.a: The tracker detects the date change and starts a fresh day automatically.
